_doc: Retrieval-quality fixture. The corpus models a small product+infra knowledge base; the queries probe whether the retriever surfaces the right chunk under exact-keyword, paraphrase, and multi-keyword conditions. Edit deliberately — the regression test asserts a baseline against this set.

corpus.title: Authentication uses JWT tokens
corpus.body: We decided to use JWT with RS256 for stateless auth. Session duration is 8 hours. The auth middleware verifies tokens against a public key cached from the IdP.

corpus.title: OAuth flow for third-party login
corpus.body: Authorization code grant with PKCE for SPAs. The redirect URI must be registered with the provider. State cookie is HttpOnly, SameSite=lax.

corpus.title: Rate limiting anti-pattern
corpus.body: No rate limiting on the webhook endpoint is a recurring risk and anti-pattern. Add a token bucket per source IP.

corpus.title: ADR-0001: Zero npm dependencies in core
corpus.body: Core CLI must have zero npm dependencies. Providers may bring their own. Rationale: a package install error must never break the agent loop.

corpus.title: ADR-0002: Layered architecture
corpus.body: Five layers: core, providers, runtime, dashboard, deploy. Core never imports from runtime. Providers are stateless adapters.

corpus.title: Weekly snapshot — 2026-04-28
corpus.body: Risks: rate limiting not configured. Health: all providers connected. Approvals queue: 3 items pending.

corpus.title: Docker build optimisation
corpus.body: Multi-stage Docker builds reduced image size by 40%. Use a slim base, copy only the build outputs, and pin the registry digest.

corpus.title: Postgres pgvector setup
corpus.body: Install the vector extension, declare embedding columns at the engine's dimension, build an HNSW index. Tune ef_search per workload.

corpus.title: Testing strategy for hooks
corpus.body: Hooks fail-open and silent failure regressions. Use an in-memory mock for stdin, snapshot the JSONL telemetry, and assert exit codes per branch.

corpus.title: Release process and versioning
corpus.body: Cut a release branch, freeze non-critical merges, run release:check. Tag SemVer. Roll forward only — no force-push to main.
